//: Config for the local PolyScope X simulator (a UR10e). ONE server: case 1/run_server.sh with no host argument stays on 127.0.0.1 and pins UR_MODEL=ur10e, launching case 1/server.py with UR_VISION=1 so case 1/camera's vision tools mount into it (44 tools). It still runs under sudo because the camera is a real D435 even when the robot is simulated -- the NOPASSWD rule in /etc/sudoers.d/vision-tools must name this exact path, with the space in 'case 1' backslash-escaped. Copy this over .mcp.json and restart Claude Code.
